arithmetic: Exact integers/Fraction and Gaussian Fraction; deterministic; no random seed.
conventions: Travel-order path algebra; matrices E_(h,tau h); graph cycle edges plus vacuum exits.

graph_relation_matrix.scope: Exact relation-matrix diagnostics; graph-algebra K-theory theorem is external.

Fock_graph.scope: Exact actions on bounded inputs in the infinite formal path basis; no compression.

scaled_circle.scope: Gaussian-rational point evaluations and finite path identities only. Not a proof of polar-curve injectivity or infinite C*-generation.
